title: Great sturdy racks.
text: Great sturdy racks.. I have seen all the big chefs using these when they fry chicken and take it out of the oil to drain...they put the chicken on one of these in a cookie sheet. It really lets the food drain well and really keeps the chicken crispy and not swimming in oil. I have always wanted these. What really surprised me is how heavy they are! I have the usual cookie cooling racks that I would put the fried chicken on, but they are very flimsy and not very good. These are like 2 layers of steel with a pocket in between the layers..they are that strong and sturdy. So easy to clean as well. Definatly recommend these racks.

description: This grate is Commonly used by professional chefs as a cooling rack, used for baking, decorating etc... Foods such as fish sticks, tatter tot's, French fry's will crisp up better on the bottom using this grate. Other fatty foods such as bacon and other meats will drip into your sheet pan keeping the bacon from sitting in it's own grease.
